title: Step
description: One step in the student checklist, with its guide. The file name without .json is the step's id: lowercase words joined by hyphens, for example tax-code.json.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, so editors get autocomplete and error highlighting. Use "../step.schema.json".

title.description: Short, action-style title shown on the checklist, for example "Get your tax code".

optional.description: true if the student can skip this step, like the SIM card or bank account.

startFromHome.description: true if the student can start this step before travelling. If true, the guide needs a fromHome section; if false, it needs an afterArrival section.

requires.description: Steps that must be done first. Use [] if none.

step.description: Id of the required step, which is its file name without .json.

status.description: "confirmed" if checked against an official source. "unknown" links are not shown to students as firm requirements.

deadline.description: The step's deadline, or null if it has none.

sources.description: Official sources for this step. The first one is shown as the main source.

title.description: Name of the source page as shown to students.

url.description: Full https link to the source page.

lastChecked.description: Date the facts were last checked against the sources, as YYYY-MM-DD.

guide.description: The guide shown when the student opens the step. Each section is a list of short paragraphs or items in plain English.

whatItIs.description: What this step is and why it matters.

bring.description: Documents and things to bring, one per item. Mark an item optional if not every student needs it, and say in its text when it is needed.

fromHome.description: How to do it before travelling. Required if startFromHome is true.

afterArrival.description: How to do it after arriving in Bolzano. Required if startFromHome is false.

commonMistakes.description: Mistakes students often make, one per item.

whatComesNext.description: What this step unlocks or what to do after it.

text.description: What to bring. For an optional item, include when it is needed, for example "..., if someone else applies for you".

optional.description: true if only some students need this item. Leave it out for items everyone must bring.
